instruction.name: vfrstpi.b
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, find the first negative 8-bit element in `b`. Write its index into the lane of `a` selected by `imm` modulo 16, or write the maximum valid index plus one if no such element exists. Other elements of `a` remain unchanged.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vfrstpi.b $vr0, $vr8, 1; vfrstpi.b $vr1, $vr9, 1; vfrstpi.b $vr2, $vr10, 1; vfrstpi.b $vr3, $vr11, 1; vfrstpi.b $vr4, $vr12, 1; vfrstpi.b $vr5, $vr13, 1; vfrstpi.b $vr6, $vr14, 1; vfrstpi.b $vr7, $vr15, 1

notes: LSX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with integer vector operands.
